name: Website Shortcuts
summary: Prefer website shortcuts (Arc): a page that uses a browser shortcut gets it; press it again for the browser's.

settings.title: Prefer website shortcuts
settings.description: A page that uses a shortcut (⌘F in a document, ⌘D in a design tool…) gets it; press it twice quickly, or on a page that doesn't use it, for the browser's. Tab and window shortcuts always stay the browser's.
